# Research brief

<!-- Synthetic fixture for the UWS research-team tests (apocalypt.md P1 fields). -->

## Objective
Decide whether the headline AUC of the fixture model survives a grouped split.

## Success criteria
The decision rule in the hypothesis row is applied before the result is inspected.

## Available evidence
One synthetic results file, artifacts/model_results.json.

## Constraints
Local compute only; no new data collection.

## Consequences of failure
An optimistic number would be reported to the PI as if it were held-out performance.
